summary: Design and build a modern, premium, high-end restaurant website for "Royal Flame" with an elegant, warm, minimal luxury aesthetic and a conversion-focused responsive homepage.
architectural_notes: Visual style: cream/white background with dark brown accents and gold highlights; elegant serif headings with clean sans-serif body typography; warm luxurious minimal look.
UX/UI requirements: fully responsive layout, modern spacing, soft shadows, smooth scroll animations, clean professional conversion-focused layout.

existing_features.title: Implement a single-page, section-based homepage for “Royal Flame” with anchor navigation and the following sections in order: Hero, About, Featured Menu, Why Choose Us, Gallery, Testimonials, Reservations, Location, Footer.
Create a sticky top navbar with a left-aligned Royal Flame logo, menu links (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact), and a right-aligned gold-accent “Reservation” button.

Implement the full-width Hero section using a high-quality restaurant interior background image with a dark gradient overlay, heading text “Experience Fine Dining Like Never Before”, an emotional subheading tagline, and two CTAs: “Reserve a Table” (primary gold button) and “View Menu” (outline style).
Implement the About section as a split layout: left side image, right side a short story paragraph plus three highlight items: Fresh Ingredients, Award Winning Chefs, Cozy Atmosphere.
Implement a Featured Menu section showing exactly 6 food items in a responsive grid; each card includes a food image, name, short description, and price, with a soft shadow hover effect.
Implement a “Why Choose Us” section with 4 icon-based features: Premium Quality, Live BBQ, Private Dining Rooms, Fast Service.
Implement a Gallery section as a responsive grid of food and interior images with a lightbox preview effect (open image in an overlay with next/previous controls and close).
Implement a Testimonials section with centered card layout showing customer review text and a star rating for each testimonial.

Implement a Reservations section containing a booking form with fields: Name, Phone, Date, Time, Guests, and a gold-accent “Reserve” button; include basic client-side validation and a clear success state after submit.
Implement a Location section with an embedded map placeholder area plus address and contact information presented clearly.
Implement a Footer with 4 columns: About, Quick Links, Opening Hours, Social Media.

Apply the specified brand style across the page: elegant/warm/minimal luxury; cream/white backgrounds, dark brown accents, gold highlights; elegant serif for headings and clean sans-serif for body; modern spacing, soft shadows, and smooth scrolling behavior.

Add and use generated static image assets for the hero, about, featured menu items, gallery, and a simple Royal Flame logo, stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly from the frontend.
